verdict.rationale: Motion has a documented REST API (API reference, cookbooks) that supports managing projects and tasks, but no evidence explicitly covers programmatic management of event types, availability, or booking flows — the only booking-related feature shown is an embeddable AI Calendar widget, not an API endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit API docs/endpoints for event types, availability rules, and booking creation/management, plus any independent developer corroboration of using the API for scheduling integrations.
